note: Every judged result is reproducible from these frozen files with no network access.

sources.name: Public Access AEDs
sources.role: Existing public-access AED network (the Feb 2020 registry snapshot).

sources.name: Master Plan 2019 Planning Area Boundary (No Sea)
sources.role: Toa Payoh planning-area boundary; clips every layer. 'No Sea' variant is required so hexes are never generated over water.

sources.name: Master Plan 2019 Subzone Boundary (No Sea)
sources.role: Subzone polygons for the worst-served-subzone equity metric.

sources.name: OpenStreetMap buildings and POIs, TOA PAYOH planning area
sources.role: Candidate building footprints, tag allowlist signal, and the floor-area / POI-density demand proxies.
transformations: Clipped to the MP2019 TOA PAYOH planning-area polygon (No Sea).
Retained only the 11 tags the pipeline consumes; the remaining OSM tag columns were dropped unread.
Written as GeoParquet rather than GeoJSON for size.
sources.notes: OSM is unversioned: a later refetch returns different data. This frozen extract, not the live API, is the source of truth.
